== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' screenshot of one entry of a LinkedIn profile's Experience list, 780 × 173 px.
* '''Purpose:''' cites his Decipher entry on [[Mark Schaffer]].
* '''Portion used:''' one entry only; the rest of the page is left out.
* '''Replaceability:''' the page sits behind a LinkedIn sign-in, so readers cannot check the entry without an account.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial excerpt on a fan encyclopedia has no effect on any market for the page.
* '''Copyright:''' text by Mark Schaffer; page layout LinkedIn. Used under fair use as a citation.
